description: Mediation Boards Commission - Calling for nominations for the appointment of Mediators - 2019
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the appointment of judicial officers (mediators) to Mediation Boards, which falls under judicial/law enforcement matters. It involves calling for nominations for judicial positions (Chairman and Mediators) and outlines eligibility criteria and appointment procedures for these judicial roles, making it a Type 9 classification rather than a government personnel or organizational matter.
